sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Which public sources to read. calOesZones: Cal OES statewide active evacuation zones. calFireZones: CAL FIRE statewide evacuation status zones. calFireIncidents: CAL FIRE active incidents. caltransClosures: Caltrans lane and road closures.

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Only keep records in these California counties (for example Los Angeles). Leave empty for the whole state.

boundingBox.title: Bounding box
boundingBox.description: Only keep records whose geometry touches this box. Degrees in WGS84: west, south, east, north.

closureDetail.title: Road closures to include
closureDetail.description: full: only roads, ramps and connectors that are fully closed right now. all: also single-lane closures, reported with status open.

staleAfterHours.title: Treat zones as stale after (hours)
staleAfterHours.description: A zone whose source record has not been edited for this long is marked stale: true and is never sent to the webhook. Counties sometimes leave old orders in the statewide layer.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: If set, the Actor POSTs { zones: [...] } here for zones in warning or order that are new or changed since the last run.

closureWebhookUrl.title: Road closure webhook URL
closureWebhookUrl.description: If set, the Actor POSTs { closures: [...] } here: each full road closure once when it starts (status closed, with its geometry), and once more with status lifted when the source stops reporting it. A Caltrans district whose feed failed this run never reports a closure as lifted.

drill.title: Drill mode
drill.description: Adds a synthetic evacuation zone in warning status from the drill polygon, a synthetic full road closure from the drill closure line, or both. Every drill record has drill: true. Off by default; real records are never altered.

drillPolygon.title: Drill polygon
drillPolygon.description: Ring of [longitude, latitude] pairs for the drill zone, at least three.

drillZoneName.title: Drill zone name
drillZoneName.description: Name shown for the drill zone.

drillClosure.title: Drill closure line
drillClosure.description: Line of [longitude, latitude] pairs along a street, at least two, for a synthetic full road closure sent to the closure webhook. A later drill run without it reports the closure lifted.

drillClosureName.title: Drill closure name
drillClosureName.description: Name shown for the drill closure.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per request timeout for each source.
